    Left global dimension #

    This file records the algebra-wide projective-dimension bound used to terminate all simple resolutions at one common homological length.

    A fully faithful exact functor which preserves projective objects reflects finite projective-dimension bounds.

    def LargeIndecomposable.HasLeftGlobalDimensionLE (A : Type u) [Ring A] (n : ℕ) :
    Prop

    A ring has left global dimension at most n in a fixed universe when every left module in that universe has projective dimension at most n.
